title: should default to light mode on a fresh load with no theme key
verifies: a fresh load with no localStorage theme key boots in light mode (.dark absent on <html>)

title: should boot in dark mode when theme is seeded to 'dark' before app scripts run
verifies: pre-seeding localStorage theme='dark' before navigation makes the first paint dark

title: should fall back to light mode for a corrupt non-'dark' theme value
verifies: a corrupt/legacy theme value (e.g. 'DARK') resolves to light via strict === 'dark' comparison
